name: Stabilized Black Pudding OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-06: Signal from the Electric Laboratory

generalAbilities.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
generalAbilities.description: A black pudding can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

defensiveAbilities.name: Corrosive Mass
defensiveAbilities.description: A creature that hits the pudding with a metal or wooden weapon must succeed at a DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw save or the weapon takes 2d6 Acid Damage damage (after dealing damage to the black pudding as normal). Thrown weapons and ammunition take this damage automatically with no save.

defensiveAbilities.name: Splorch
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An adjacent creature hits the black pudding jelly with a Strike that would deal slashing or piercing damage

Effect A gout of acidic jelly shoots out at the attacker. The attacker must attempt a DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The attacker is unaffected.

Success The attacker takes 1d8 Acid Damage damage.

Failure The attacker takes 2d8 Acid Damage damage.

Critical Failure The attacker takes 2d8 Acid Damage damage and 4 persistent acid damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(1d8+7) Bludgeoning Damage]{1d8+7 bludgeoning damage plus 1d6 acid damage}, Basic DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Corrosive Touch
offensiveAbilities.description: When the pudding hits a creature with its pseudopod, any acid damage is dealt to the creature's armor or clothing as well as the creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Suction
offensiveAbilities.description: The pudding can climb on ceilings and other inverted surfaces, though such surfaces are difficult terrain for it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
